web.marketplace: Community Marketplace for AI Agent Plugins
web.heroDescription: HarnessHub turns plugin sources, versions, permissions, compatibility and licensing into a registry people can actually evaluate.
web.registryFirstDescription: This phase reads manually allowlisted DSH sources through immutable GitHub and npm evidence. Community and payment features are intentionally absent.
web.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, author, or category
web.tryDifferentSearch: Try a different name, author, or category.
web.principleOneBody: Structured plugin evidence instead of an unfiltered repository list.
web.principleTwoBody: Transparent roles and rules, introduced only when their phase is ready.
web.principleThreeBody: Browsing stays open. Trust labels keep one precise, auditable meaning.
web.footerPositioning: Community Marketplace for AI Agent Plugins

desktop.scope: Read-only runtime detection is enabled. Installation and system changes remain blocked.
desktop.title: Registry data, clearly explained.
desktop.description: The desktop reads the Registry and uses fixed arguments for read-only runtime detection. Setup Assistant only generates a plan; plugin installation remains simulated.

installation.title: Safe installation flow demo
installation.description: Validate analysis, permission review, a simulated transaction, and recovery states. No plugin, script, or system setting is touched.
installation.simulationOnly: A simulated result does not mean the plugin was really installed
installation.signInTitle: Sign in to start the simulation
installation.signInBody: Installation transactions must belong to an authenticated user. The prototype enforces the same boundary.
installation.riskReason: Declares project file access and install-time code. The demo will not execute either capability.
installation.reasonNetworkAccess: Connect to the service declared by the plugin
installation.reasonProjectFileRead: Read content in the project you select
installation.reasonProjectFileWrite: Modify content in the project you select
installation.reasonShellExecution: Run commands required by the plugin
installation.reasonInstallTimeCode: Prepare plugin files; this demo shows the warning but never executes it
installation.resultInstalled: The simulated flow completed. No file or system state was changed.
installation.resultCancelled: Cancelled before execution. No installation action occurred.
installation.resultRolledBack: The simulated failure entered rollback and completed it.
installation.resultRecoveryRequired: The simulated rollback failed. Recovery is explicitly required and the result is not presented as success.
installation.auditEmpty: State changes appear here after analysis starts.
installation.unauthorized: The current user cannot access this simulated transaction.

runtime.title: Runtime and DSH status
runtime.description: Detect this device's operating system, architecture, Node.js, Git, and DSH. Detection never installs software or changes the system.
runtime.readOnlyBody: Only Node.js, Git, and DSH version queries are allowed. User commands, paths, and extra arguments are not accepted.
runtime.detectionFailed: Runtime detection could not finish. No installation or system change was attempted.
runtime.packagedOnly: Real environment detection is available only in the packaged HarnessHub Desktop. The web preview does not inspect your computer.
runtime.planOnly: This is a plan and cannot execute
runtime.planOnlyBody: Confirmation only completes the Setup Assistant simulation. It does not download DSH, create a Profile, or run a command.
runtime.stepPrepareDshBody: Plan how an approved DSH release would be obtained.
runtime.stepCreateProfileBody: Plan an isolated HarnessHub user Profile.
runtime.permissions: Permissions required by a future real setup
runtime.permissionNetworkBody: A future setup may access the network for a pinned release artifact.
runtime.permissionProfileBody: A future setup may create an isolated HarnessHub Profile.
runtime.permissionRuntimeBody: A future setup may run only an allowlisted DSH verification operation.
runtime.confirmedBody: The plan was confirmed, but nothing was downloaded, installed, executed, or changed.
runtime.trustedBoundaryBody: Future evaluation is limited to official test plugins, LOW risk, a complete Manifest, and a Verified Developer. HIGH/CRITICAL cannot be automatically installed.
runtime.futureEligibleNoAuto: Eligible for a future controlled evaluation; automatic installation remains disabled.
runtime.futureBlocked: This candidate does not meet the future controlled-install boundary.

plugin.permissionsPending: Permissions not assessed in the Registry phase
plugin.upstreamUnavailable: Upstream unavailable. Historical snapshots remain available.
plugin.noSourceStatus: No production source status exists for this fixture.
plugin.permissionNotice: Permission analysis is intentionally outside the Registry phase. No safety conclusion is attached.
plugin.snapshotNotReview: Source snapshot, not a safety review
plugin.testFixtureNotice: This record is test-only and must not enter the production Registry.
plugin.snapshotNotice: HarnessHub cross-checked the listed GitHub and npm identities at the recorded time. No install action, safety endorsement, or developer verification is attached.
